entities.summary: Gabriel Paul Joseph Dumont is a Canadian former professional ice hockey forward. He was selected in the fifth round, 139th overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2009 NHL entry draft. Dumont played for the Canadiens, Minnesota Wild, Ottawa Senators, and Tampa Bay Lightning.
